originalTitle: 10-year Treasury yield inches higher as traders digest soft retail sales, monitor the Middle East
summary: The moves come after the latest retail sales figures missed expectations and the U.S. said its naval blockade of Iranian ports could continue "indefinitely."
content:
The 10-year U.S. Treasury note yield rose on Friday after the latest retail sales figures missed expectations and the U.S. said its naval blockade of Iranian ports could continue "indefinitely."

The 10-year yield — the key benchmark for U.S. government borrowing — rose more than 5 basis points to 4.696%.

The 2-year Treasury note yield, which more closely tracks short-term Federal Reserve interest rate policy, added 3 basis points to 4.171%. The longer-dated 30-year Treasury bond yield advanced nearly 6 basis points to 5.267%.

One basis point is equal to 0.01%, and yields and prices move in opposite directions.

Retail sales surprisingly fell in July, dropping 0.6%. Economists polled by Dow Jones had called for a 0.1% rise.

Yields initially jumped after U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent 's comments in an interview with Newsmax, in which he warned of fresh measures aimed at the "economic isolation" of Iran which "have never been seen."

Bessent's comments follow U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth telling reporters that U.S. forces could maintain an indefinite blockade of Iranian ports.

The producer price index, which measures what wholesalers pay for raw goods and materials, was flat month over month in July . Economists polled by Dow Jones expected an increase of 0.2%.

Thursday's print follows a tame reading on consumer inflation, with the consumer price index coming in line with economist expectations.

"US inflation data this week has been contained and very welcome for Treasuries," ING strategists wrote in a note Friday. "It absolutely eases higher rates pressure. But that pressure is far from gone. Real yields are higher and will likely remain so."

— CNBC's Hugh Leask also contributed to this report.
chineseTitle: 随着交易员消化零售销售疲软并监控中东，十年期国债收益率小幅走高
chineseSummary: 在此之前，最新的零售销售数据未达到预期，而且美国表示对伊朗港口的海上封锁可能会“无限期”持续下去。
chineseContent:
在最新零售销售数据未达预期且美国表示对伊朗港口的海上封锁可能“无限期”持续后，美国10年期国债收益率周五上涨。

10 年期国债收益率（美国政府借款的主要基准）上涨超过 5 个基点，至 4.696%。

更密切地跟踪美联储短期利率政策的2年期国债收益率上涨3个基点至4.171%。较长期的30年期国债收益率上涨近6个基点至5.267%。

1个基点等于0.01%，收益率和价格走势相反。

7 月份零售额出人意料地下降，下降了 0.6%。接受道琼斯调查的经济学家预计涨幅为 0.1%。

美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent) 在接受 Newsmax 采访时发表评论后，收益率最初大幅上涨，他在采访中警告称，将采取“前所未有”的旨在“经济孤立”伊朗的新措施。

贝森特发表此番言论之前，美国国防部长皮特·赫格斯告诉记者，美军可能会无限期封锁伊朗港口。

生产者价格指数（衡量批发商购买原材料的价格）7 月份环比持平。道琼斯调查的经济学家预计增长0.2%。

周四公布的消费者通胀数据温和，消费者价格指数符合经济学家的预期。

ING策略师周五在一份报告中写道：“本周美国通胀数据受到遏制，对美国国债来说非常受欢迎。” “这绝对缓解了利率上升的压力。但这种压力还远未消失。实际收益率更高，并且很可能保持不变。”

— CNBC 的休·利斯克 (Hugh Leask) 也为本报告做出了贡献。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
